2. The count is scripts/cost.sh (read its header and the header of scripts/cost-hot.txt): fifteen probes, each built at a base and at the tree and run under callgrind, every function's own instructions compared by canonical name, at the slacks CLAUDE.md gives ("sh scripts/cost.sh BASE is the count made one command" and the paragraphs after it). The plan's rows are these probes: row 1 read; row 2 scan and scan_long; row 3 read_z, scan_z and scan_long_z; row 4 merge; row 5 work; row 6 load_durable, load_buffered, commit_durable, commit_buffered; row 7 seal; row 8 scan_at; and land, the segment work on the writer's thread, which the plan had no row for. A unit's evidence for rule 1 is "sh scripts/cost.sh <the commit HEAD was at when the unit began> <the probes of its rows>" ending in the line "cost: green" with exit status 0, the log kept in the unit's directory with its EXIT line; run land too wherever the unit touches src/ordindex.rs, src/flatindex.rs or anything a merge's landing or a settle calls. Keep the base's target between runs (COST_BASE_TARGET) so the base is built once, give each run a COST_DIR of its own, read df first (a run of all fifteen is most of an hour and several gigabytes; a link that dies with "ld terminated with signal 7" is the disk), and remove the base's target when the unit's last run is done. A function that reads red because code moved between functions (inlining that changed, a helper split out or folded in) is not a cost and is not waved through either: the notes name it with its callers and callees and the function that lost the same instructions, by the listing, and the reviewers read that. The gate is never weakened to read green: no line of scripts/cost-hot.txt, no bound and no slack changes, except a `~` line's bound on evidence of noise from the tree counted against itself, said in the notes. Before touching src/blob.rs, src/flatindex.rs or src/ordindex.rs read CLAUDE.md's paragraphs on what the plain store was found paying there ("Naming the second walk inside the first cost the first", "The same shape twice more"): an arm for a source that lends by the piece written into a function the plain path inlines has cost the plain path every time it was tried, and a cold arm that returns into a hot caller costs the caller its registers; the shape that has held is the arm out of line in a function the plain path does not name, and it is counted, not assumed.

3. The earlier units' gates bind this one. tests/source.rs holds: the wall (tests/data/couplings.txt, counts of tokens by file and region between the forms and the encryption modules); the door (tests/data/door.txt and door-libc.txt, and scripts/door/run.sh in the lint group: file, mapping, advice, sync and process-read calls barred by symbol outside vault, bytes, pager, crypt, dirkey and blocks); the cost gate's entry points (tests/data/cost-entries.txt: every public method of Reader, Db and Blob has a probe or a reason, so a public method a unit adds needs its line); and every file under .github/workflows. Those lists only go down, and that is held by the lists group (in the default set: scripts/ratchet.sh, scripts/ratchet.py, the base from scripts/base.sh): a count the tree has above the base's is red unless scripts/raises.txt declares it (tab-separated: list, key, from, to, reason). A declared raise is for a raise the unit's section of the plan requires and for nothing else: prefer the shape that raises no count, and where none exists the notes say which count, by how much, and why no shape avoids it, for the reviewers to hold. A list a unit adds is registered in scripts/ratchet.py (there is no CODEOWNERS file: the owner decided the lists are held by a check). A CI job a unit adds is "sh scripts/check.sh <group>" with nothing in the YAML but the event's values. Run "sh scripts/check.sh lists" and the lint group before you finish the build step, not only at the commit.

4. The unit gate the commit step runs now includes the lists group, and the wasm group for a unit that changes compiled engine code (the commit step's own text says so). The full gate's default set is build test stride lint wasm bench lists.
